By virtue of the authority vested in me by section 204 of Part II of the act entitled "AN ACT Making appropriations for the Legislative Branch of the Government for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1933, and for other purposes" approved June 30, 1932, John P. HERBERT HOOVER

The White House,

August 24, 1932.
